module: Flowgraph node "Mission Defaults" (category provider). Provides default values common to missions: markerInactive (light orange RGBA color {232,132,52}/255), markerActive (light green RGBA color {156,229,61}/255, for the 3D markers of the Parking Markers node) and fadeTransitionTime (0.75 s). The values are set only once when execution starts.
notes: The pin descriptions say "Inactive" for both colors (copy-paste in the code); markerActive is indeed the green color.

init.desc: Disables clearOutPinsOnStart so that the outputs keep their values.

_executionStarted.desc: Writes the values of the three output pins when the graph starts.
